locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Ergo necesse est devenire ad aliquod primum movens, quod a nullo movetur
interpretation: Weaker sibling of reading A. 'A nullo movetur' is read relative to the series: the first mover is moved by nothing in any respect relevant to its moving, though it may be moved in other respects. This is the conclusion the relevant-respect reading of the per se premise supports.
